title: Mutual Debiasing via Dual-Seed Comparison for Probabilistic Sampling in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.26161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in reasoning and decision-making, high-fidelity probabilistic sampling remains a persistent challenge. When generating random variables, LLMs consistently exhibit systematic biases that warp the target probability distributions. Current approaches often rely on a single, self-generated seed, which inherits model-specific biases. To overcome this vulnerability, we introduce Dual-Seed Comparison (DSC), a transparent, tool-free protocol that utilizes two independent LLM-generated seeds to neutralize bias. DSC compares the character-level ordinal values of the two seeds to construct a bit sequence, converts and normalizes this sequence into a pseudo-uniform variate, and then maps the variate to the target distribution through the inverse cumulative distribution function (CDF). translated_title: 通过双种子比较实现大型语言模型概率采样的互惠去偏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26161v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在推理和决策方面表现出显著能力，但高保真概率采样仍然是一个持续的挑战。在生成随机变量时，LLMs 始终表现出系统性偏差，扭曲了目标概率分布。当前方法通常依赖单一的自生成种子，这继承了模型特定的偏差。为克服这一脆弱性，我们引入了双种子比较（DSC），一种透明、无工具依赖的协议，利用两个独立的 LLM 生成种子来中和偏差。DSC 比较两个种子的字符级序数值以构建比特序列，将该序列转换并归一化为伪均匀变量，然后通过逆累积分布函数（CDF）将变量映射到目标分布。实证结果表明，DSC 在96%的案例中显著优于现有方法。
tldr: 本文提出双种子比较（DSC）方法，通过比较两个独立 LLM 生成的种子来中和采样偏差，从而提升概率采样的保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Dual-Seed Comparison (DSC), which neutralizes sampling bias by comparing two independent LLM-generated seeds, improving probabilistic sampling fidelity.
